context: You find Golbraith Stredivas when you break into a house while exploring the city: an aging, solitary mind‑flayer hunter who mutters to himself and keeps to his home. He’s retired—left crippled or otherwise sidelined by an illithid trap—and is clearly proud but frightened for his son, who is currently out tracking one of the beasts and is described as an even better hunter. Golbraith is guarded but talkative when eased (offering him a drink will loosen his tongue), and doing so will reward the player with grounded fan‑tribute lore about mind flayers and his family.
